title: Make the Base Destructor Virtual
learning_objective: Recognize when a polymorphic base class intended for deletion through a base pointer needs a virtual destructor.
instructions: Entity is a polymorphic base class with a public destructor. Fix Entity so deleting a derived object through an Entity pointer is supported correctly. Submit the complete program.
hints: Entity already has a virtual member function, so it is being used polymorphically.
A public base destructor used for polymorphic deletion should be virtual.
Add virtual to Entity's destructor declaration.
explanation: When an object may be deleted through a pointer to a polymorphic base class, the base destructor must be virtual so destruction dispatches to the derived destructor first. The analyzer verifies Clang's CXXDestructorDecl for Entity is actually virtual.
